# THE OPTICAL HUB — Best Optician in Jaipur

> THE OPTICAL HUB is a 5.0★ Google-rated optical boutique and eye clinic in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Managed by optometrist Ramesh Sharma with 15+ years of clinical experience, the clinic provides free 5-minute digital eye examinations, in-store designer eyeglasses, blue-cut computer lenses, progressive bifocals, same-day spectacle repairs, virtual selfie try-on, and 24/7 AI-assisted enquiry handling.

## Clinical & Eyewear Services
- **Free 5-Minute Eye Test:** Digital vision test for sphere, cylinder, and axis powers with instant WhatsApp booking.
- **Home Eye Testing for Seniors:** Doorstep optometrist visit with trial lens kit across Jaipur for ₹199.
- **Eyewear Collections:** Gents, Ladies, Kids, and Sunglasses categories.
  - Budget ranges: Under ₹999 (Value), ₹999–₹1,999 (Mid), ₹1,999–₹4,000 (High), ₹4,000+ (Luxury Designer).
- **Lens Options:** Single vision power lenses, anti-glare blue-cut computer glasses, progressive bifocals, anti-scratch and UV400 coatings.
- **Spectacle Repair Desk:** Same-day repairs starting at ₹49 for loose screws, nose pad replacement, temple soldering, and frame realignment.
- **Medical-Grade Prescription Vault:** Encrypted local prescription storage with PIN protection and privacy compliance.
- **24/7 AI Night Calling Voice Agent:** Answers customer questions about store timings, repair status, pricing, and directions even when the clinic is closed.
- **Virtual Selfie Try-On:** Interactive camera mirror to test aviator, rectangular, round, and cat-eye frames before visiting the physical store.
